description: The crew reaches the final stage of its voyage as rival groups, hidden agendas and discoveries about the changed world force the survivors to decide whom they can trust and what future remains possible.

s03e01.description: Burbuja secretly tracks Manolito and concludes that the duck is returning to nearby solid ground, while memories of his abduction suggest a military submarine is still following the Estrella Polar.

s03e02.description: A distant lighthouse offers the first convincing sign of land, but its light suddenly vanishes, prompting Gamboa to train a defensive team before the ship approaches.

s03e03.description: Ainhoa returns with a Chinese prisoner who desperately warns against the mysterious light, while the students realize none of them actually applied for the voyage and unknown riders scout the ship.

s03e04.description: The Estrella Polar reaches the roof of a submerged skyscraper where 193 survivors are stranded, forcing the crew to confront an impossible rescue problem while Ulises remains missing.

s03e05.description: Armed survivors seize the Estrella Polar while Julia and the captain are trapped in a flooding elevator, leaving Ainhoa to organize a rescue as secrets about Project Alexandria surface.

s03e06.description: The captain must decide how to evacuate survivors from the unstable building with room for only fifty aboard, while he and Julia announce plans to marry despite Project Alexandria’s rules.

s03e07.description: Julia refuses Gamboa’s demand to cancel her wedding to the captain, even after learning Project Alexandria forbids the marriage and Gamboa may be ordered to stop it at any cost.

s03e08.description: Sol fears Gamboa has discovered that she is actually her twin sister Elena, Burbuja learns Salomé is his sister, and tensions rise between the ship and the survivors left behind.

s03e09.description: Sol vanishes and evidence points to murder, Ventura and his grandson Ratón emerge as hidden stowaways, and De la Cuadra tries to restore the captain’s authority through a boxing match with Gamboa.

s03e10.description: After 132 days at sea, the crew finally reaches an island, only to find a warning that they will all die and evidence that another Project Alexandria ship may have arrived first.

s03e11.description: A distress flare sends Ainhoa and others searching for the missing Max, while blood behind the laboratory wall and a hidden camera in the captain’s cabin reveal new layers of surveillance and secrecy.

s03e12.description: Masked attackers fire on the island party, forcing them to use an improvised animal-mounted camera to scout ahead, while the Estrella Polar discovers the hotel survivors have vanished without trace.

s03e13.description: Icebergs trap the Estrella Polar as another vessel closes in, while Gamboa tries to trade the Project Alexandria red folder for his kidnapped daughter and learns the folder has been switched.

s03e14.description: A wounded Max returns with a warning from another Project Alexandria crew, Piti impersonates Gamboa to protect captured friends and Valeria and Ratón secretly launch their own raft toward the island.

s03e15.description: The Estrella Polar finally reaches the island and mounts a rescue, while Burbuja reunites with Marimar, the girlfriend he saved before losing the memories of his former life as Roberto.

s03e16.description: Piti is used as bait after his Gamboa impersonation is exposed, Burbuja must pretend his old intellect has returned and Gamboa faces an order to kill Ulises as Valeria fights for her life.
